rulesTestNames: lets current managers list the by-hand queue and never write it
read: current organizer managers get and list (organizerId equality) while their account is not deleted; the Sends by-hand queue listens to active tasks
write: server only with deterministic idempotency and optimistic revisions
migrationNotes: Prepare persists a bounded 30-day external-handoff task before the first client launch; every later launch is revision-bound and revalidates current endpoint and permission immediately before opening the external app.
handoffOpened is device acceptance only and hostMarkedSent is an explicit organizer assertion; neither is provider delivery or read evidence.
Re-plan is read-only and never dispatches, completes, removes, or supersedes task state.
